uses: Contact identity for optional reconciliation only; names/addresses do not become auth identity
SR/RFC/WFM identities, aliases and terminal/cascade decisions
Spare Request/RMA/Fault Tag identities and Inventory proposal targets

provides: communication panels, proposal review states, coverage/job status and terminal summaries
local-source trust boundary, redaction requirements, parser/library attack surface
append-oriented link/proposal/purge history and chronology distinctions

forbidden_dependencies: Communication parsing/matching cannot write owning-domain lifecycle state directly.
Source coverage/discovery/index times cannot substitute for unknown external message/business chronology.
Master data such as Network Element, Device Reference, Site, Rack, Contact or Customer alone cannot satisfy the trackable-entity gate.
Provider terminal RFC evidence cannot unlink Communications before confirmed local cascade.
Purging reconstructable message content cannot cascade-delete domain entities, audit history, backups or external source files.
MSG generation/export cannot mark a message sent or advance communication coverage.
transaction_boundary: Jobs may parse/match outside write transactions. Each committed batch revalidates Source Scope, canonical identity, target registry and current protected dependencies, then atomically persists messages/links/proposals/coverage checkpoint and required audit. Orphan due-time purge uses its own transaction and revalidates all protected dependencies immediately before deletion of reconstructable content.
